import os,re,glob

      'AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorFamily*.lean','AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivScheme*.lean',
      'AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean','AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree.lean']
files=sorted({f for p in pats for f in glob.glob(p)})
print("seam files:",len(files))
decl=re.compile(r'^(?:@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)?(?:private\s+|protected\s+|noncomputable\s+)?(class|structure)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_\'.]+)',re.M)
tot=[]
for f in files:
    s=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    for m in decl.finditer(s):
        tot.append((f,m.group(1),m.group(2)))
print("total class/structure decls on seam:",len(tot))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(k for _,k,_ in tot))
for f,k,n in tot: print(f"{k:9s} {n:45s} {f}")
